question: Which current WordPress, Elementor, and Elementor Free APIs constrain the Admin V0.2 implementation?
reason: Avoid custom code that duplicates stable platform APIs and avoid relying on stale plugin assumptions.
decision_dependency: Whether shared admin components, icon loading, preview modal behavior, and saved options can reuse existing WordPress/Elementor APIs.
update_policy: Recheck when implementation starts because WordPress and Elementor APIs can change.
plan_impact: May adjust TASK-005 component architecture and security checks.
task_impact: May split TASK-005 if existing admin save behavior is more coupled than expected.
